name: Feedback AI
description: Collects user feedback through a form and classifies each submission as Positive, Negative, or Neutral via the OpenAI Chat Completions API.
project_description: Feedback AI adds a public feedback form (name, email, message) to a Drupal site and, on submission, sends the message text to the OpenAI Chat Completions API to classify its sentiment as Positive, Negative, or Neutral. Each submission is stored in a dedicated database table (feedback_ai) together with its sentiment result. Administrators review results through a shipped View (Feedback AI Submissions) with exposed filters for sentiment and submission date, a CSV export display (backed by the Views Data Export module), and a CanvasJS pie chart block that summarizes the sentiment mix of the most recent submissions. The OpenAI credentials, endpoint, model, and max-token limit are configured on a settings form under Administration. The module ships two blocks (the feedback form and the sentiment chart), two Views date filter plugins, a Guzzle-based OpenAI client service, and an admin permission (administer feedback ai) that gates configuration and the submissions View.
